set.body:
Outcome

Compile valid scientific plans into explicit numerical strategies.

Acceptance

- Dense, operator, fused, sufficient-statistic, streaming, and collected strategies implement one task contract.
- Receipt records backend, materializations, numeric precision, solver, seeds, scheduling, work, convergence, and fallback.
- Backend changes preserve scientific identity but change execution identity.
- Fallback and densification are never silent.
set.title: P2.4: separate ExecutionPlan and ExecutionReceipt from scientific identity
